title: Scale-signal entropy mismatch during onboarding bursts — RCA and warm-pool + metric-smoothing plan
creator: Ava Martinez
description: During a customer onboarding surge on 2026-02-18 we observed oscillatory scaling behavior that led to repeated cold starts for a subset of inference pools. The incident surfaced when a spike in short-lived onboarding jobs produced noisy percentile metric distributions; KEDA scaled to zero between bursts and HPA reacted to short spikes with aggressive scaling decisions. This ticket contains the RCA, immediate mitigations applied, and a tracked plan for final fixes (warm pools, metric smoothing, and improved alerts).
timeline:
2026-02-18 09:12 UTC — Alert: surge_rate spike on onboarding-prod-queue noticed in Grafana (alert: onboarding-queue-burst)
2026-02-18 09:15 UTC — KEDA scaler for inference-pool-7 interpreted burst as sustained and created 6 replicas; HPA metrics adapter reported 95th percentile CPU/latency samples with high variance
2026-02-18 09:18 UTC — Scale-to-zero triggered for inference-pool-4 (scaleDownDelay misaligned with burst cadence)
2026-02-18 09:24 UTC — First user impact: increased 99th percentile token latency, 12% request failures for newly onboarded customers
2026-02-18 09:45 UTC — On-call engineering triaged; manual bump of minReplicas and disabled aggressive scale-down policy for affected pools
2026-02-18 10:10 UTC — Partial mitigation applied: introduced temporary warm-pool instance for inference-pool-4 and increased KEDA activation threshold
2026-02-18 11:00 UTC — Metrics stabilized; incident considered contained; follow-up items recorded
impact: Customer-visible degradation: onboarding API latency increase (99p token latency +420ms) and ~12% error rate for ~35 minutes for customers routed to affected pools. No data loss. Estimated customer impact: medium. Operational load: on-call and infra teams spent ~3.5 engineer-hours.
root_cause:
Three contributing factors:
1) Metric entropy and sampling skew: our custom request-duration adapter reports 95th/99th percentiles computed over 30s windows without smoothing. Short bursty onboarding jobs produced high variance and transient spikes that KEDA interpreted as sustained activity.
2) Conflicting scale policies: KEDA-based event-driven scaling and HPA-based CPU/latency policies lack harmonized stabilization windows. KEDA scaled up quickly but HPA/HPA-controller stabilized slower and then allowed scale-to-zero on same node groups.
3) Aggressive scale-down config: minReplicas=0 and scaleDownDelay=60s for some pools caused scale-to-zero between intermittent bursts, introducing cold-start penalties when subsequent bursts arrived.
Root cause summary: mismatch between metric aggregation/smoothing and scale decision windows combined with overly aggressive scale-down and lack of warm-pools.
mitigation:
Immediate actions taken during incident:
- Increased minReplicas from 0 to 1 for impacted inference pools
- Raised KEDA activationThreshold for onboarding queue by 30%
- Disabled automatic aggressive scale-down policy and set scaleDownDelay to 180s temporarily
- Provisioned a small warm-pool (1 replica) for high-churn onboarding customers
These measures reduced cold starts and smoothed observed latency spikes.
action_items: (P0) Implement a 3-step warm pool feature for inference pools: config-driven minHotReplicas, fast-warm path, and gradual scale-in — owner: infra/warm-pools — estimate: 8

(P1) Change percentile metric adapter to use an exponentially-weighted moving window (EWMA) for 95p/99p with a 90s half-life and emit both raw and smoothed metrics — owner: observability — estimate: 3
(P1) Introduce a 'scale-decision coordinator' that reconciles KEDA triggers and HPA stabilization windows to avoid conflicting scale actions — owner: serving-runtime — estimate: 5
(P2) Create a synthetic churn test harness (kube job) that simulates short-lived onboarding bursts with configurable cadence and intensity; add to CI nightly — owner: reliability — estimate: 3
(P2) Add dashboard panels and alerts: smoothed-percentile drift, warm-pool hit-rate, and scale-flap counter; create runbook for triage — owner: platform-observability — estimate: 2
(P0) Update autoscaling docs and public config templates to recommend conservative minReplicas / scaleDownDelay defaults for onboarding workloads — owner: devexp — estimate: 1

resolution: Containment measures (minReplicas bump, increased scaleDownDelay, temporary warm-pool) mitigated customer impact. Long-term fixes (EWMA smoothing, warm pools, scale-decision coordinator) scheduled. Cost implications estimated; infra and finance to review adaptive warm-pool policy before Q2 rollout.
